title: Possible hardcoded password assignment in source
description: A password-shaped variable is assigned a quoted literal, which suggests a real credential committed to source. Anyone with repository access can reuse it until it is rotated.
remediation: If this is a real password, rotate it immediately, audit what it accessed, and move the secret to environment variables or a secret manager. This detection does not prove the credential is live.
limitation: Shape-only: a quoted assignment that cannot prove a live credential. Only denylisted substrings (EXAMPLE, changeme) are vetoed. Angle-bracket and env-reference placeholders such as <password> or ${DB_PASSWORD} are NOT vetoed and still match (known false positive; denylist tuning is an owner decision).
